description: The navigation bar's arrow keys, language-neutral: a key pressed on the destination `from` of the destinations below, in move() from core/src/navigation-bar/connect.ts. `focus` is the destination focus moves to, or null when the key does nothing. Keys are DOM key names. direction defaults to ltr. Unavailable destinations stay in the order. There is no wrap and no Home or End. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

keys.name: Right moves to the next destination
Left moves to the previous destination
Right stops on an unavailable destination
Left stops on an unavailable destination
Right does not wrap from the last destination
Left does not wrap from the first destination
Right to left, Left moves forward
Right to left, Right moves back
Right to left, Left does not wrap from the last destination
Right to left, Right does not wrap from the first destination
